faqs.question: How long does a typical WhatsApp Marketing engagement take?
faqs.answer: Business setup, templates, and first journeys usually launch in 2–5 weeks depending on BSP approval and CRM integrations.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We connect WhatsApp to your CRM/ecommerce stack and train your team on template ops and conversation etiquette.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Opt-in growth, read/response rates, conversion from campaigns, support deflection, and revenue attributed to WhatsApp journeys.

faqs.question: Broadcasts, automation, or commerce?
faqs.answer: We design the mix: utility notifications, abandoned carts, nurture sequences, and human-assisted sales chats where high touch wins.

faqs.question: Do you help with WhatsApp Business API setup?
faqs.answer: Yes — BSP selection, number strategy, template submission, quality rating hygiene, and green-tick readiness where eligible.

faqs.question: How do you stay compliant?
faqs.answer: Opt-in capture, category-correct templates, quiet hours where required, and clear opt-out — protecting quality rating and trust.

faqs.question: Can chats hand off to sales or support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Routing rules, canned replies, and CRM notes keep conversations owned by the right teammate.

faqs.question: Will this replace email/SMS?
faqs.answer: Not usually. WhatsApp shines for high-intent and conversational moments; we place it inside an omnichannel system.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share your use cases (support, sales, alerts). We map journeys, approve templates, and pilot one high-ROI flow first.

faqs.question: Who runs campaigns after launch?
faqs.answer: Your team can operate with our playbooks, or we retain for journey iteration, creative templates, and analytics.
